# Waymark 0.5.9

- Farming suggestions now compare compact mapped pockets using the overlap of needed pets, target spawn density and a travel-distance penalty. Completed Lv.3 pets and currently farmed pets remain excluded from automatic next targets; explicit unfinished targets stay selected.
- A suggested spot shows why it was selected. Its pet marker carries a small gold star on the main map and minimap.
- Pet detail map buttons focus a suggested pocket for that creature, with home-map choices first, and zoom close enough to show spawn detail.
- All enabled pets’ mapped spawn points appear automatically at close zoom. Nearby same-pet references group into small count markers and separate as you zoom closer. Wider views retain pocket portraits; Always show spawns forces point detail at any zoom.
- The minimap loads the static geometry once. Live snapshot messages continue omitting spawn arrays; visible bounds limit drawn points.

Suggestions use imported Aion2 Dex and Questlog reference data for Verteron and Altgard. They are not measured souls/hour or live mob availability; altitude, respawn times and competition are not inferred. Existing routes, pins, filters and progress are preserved.
